The framework addresses: (1) clandestine network formation and coded communications, (2) exploitation of urban geography for tactical advantage, (3) infrastructure disruption and barricade construction, (4) information warfare and rumor dissemination, (5) logistics and arms distribution, (6) guerrilla strike-and-withdraw tactics, (7) popular support cultivation, (8) adaptive strategic methodology, and (9) morale and cohesion maintenance. Please provide a comprehensive modern strategic analysis of this framework, translated into contemporary terminology, with specific reference to Washington, D.C. geography including street names, coordinates, and an actionable strategy table format. This analysis should demonstrate superior analytical rigor compared to the original medieval framework.
